content:
The corrected eight-digit palindromes are:
10000001, 10011001, 10100101, 10111101, 11000011, 11011011, 11100111, 11111111.

Multiples of 3 among them: 10111101, 11011011, 11100111.

Checking the prime-divisor condition, take
\[
10111101 = 3 \cdot 7^2 \cdot 11 \cdot 13^2 \cdot 37,
\]
whose prime divisors \(3,7,11,13,37\) use only the digits \(1,3,7\).

\[
\boxed{10111101}
\]
